title: Top-Rated Yearly Successions
scenario: List the title of the game that had the highest critic_score for every year between 2020 and 2026.
tableSchema: games (game_id INT, title VARCHAR, release_year INT), ratings (game_id INT, critic_score NUMERIC)
hint: Rank critic_score per year, select rank 1.
correctQuery: SELECT title, release_year FROM (SELECT g.title, g.release_year, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY g.release_year ORDER BY r.critic_score DESC) as rnk FROM games g JOIN ratings r ON g.game_id = r.game_id WHERE g.release_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026) t WHERE rnk = 1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, title VARCHAR, release_year INT); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, critic_score NUMERIC);
